name: spillgate-monorepo
description: Workspace root of spillgate-js: spillgate, spillgate-br, spillgate-zstd.

scripts.build: npm run build -w spillgate-test-support && npm run build -w spillgate && npm run build -w spillgate-br && npm run build -w spillgate-zstd --if-present && npm run build -w spillgate-integration
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test -w spillgate && npm test -w spillgate-br && npm test -w spillgate-zstd --if-present && npm test -w spillgate-integration
